routeHint: Sidebar -> Chapters. The map panel must be open: only then does the 'Iframe URL' button appear (client/src/views/LocalCenter/List.vue:184). Do NOT add a click on the 'map' button: it is a toggle over a value persisted in Vuex listValues.localCenters.isMapView, which the capture session already has set to true, so clicking closes the panel. That is what produced the previous map-less shot. isMapView is pinned true in capture/state-t187c.json instead.
alt: Chapters list with the map panel open, showing pins, a status filter, a town filter, and one row per chapter with member counts
notes: Map panel must be open. 'Iframe URL' is the reliable waitFor because List.vue renders it only when isMapView is true, so a missed click cannot pass silently. Chapter coordinates are seeded (local_center.geo_location), founding dates are spread 1951-2014, counties are Virginia, and selectorNameFormat is '%name%' so names are no longer doubled. Two things verified on 2026-08-06. The MEMBERS column is NOT unit.active_member_count: it is usersCount from /stats/users-local-centers, already the whole branch total, with the descendants' share repeated in the grey (+N) (List.vue:415-428, utils/localCenterCounts.js). So Alexandria reads 95 (+69) while its own active members are 26, and app:recalculate-unit-member-counts does not change this page. Second, a fresh capture is risky: the Leaflet map did not fit to the chapter pins and rendered centred on Kansas. Open the shipped PNG before keeping any recapture, and revert rather than ship a map with no pins in frame.

routeHint: Direct URL, signed out. The standalone Google Maps chapter finder (simple layout, anonymous-accessible). Uses capture/state-anon-t187c.json, a session with NO auth cookie but with the tenant already warm in the persisted Vuex store; rebuild it with capture/make-anon-state.mjs.
alt: Public chapter finder with a postal code search box, age group, cost, night and language filters, a results list, and pins on a Google map
notes: Captured signed out, so the 'Logged in as' chip is gone (it is gated on user?.id, MapView.vue:14). Headless Chromium denies geolocation, so MapView falls back to calculateCenterFromAllLocalCenters(); with chapter coordinates seeded in Virginia that centres on Virginia instead of the hardcoded Romania fallback at MapView.vue:860,871. A cold anonymous load does NOT work: the Google Maps callback fires before GET /tenants?slug= resolves, so loadAllCentersData() throws 'Cannot read properties of null (reading slug)' at MapView.vue:1395 and no chapters are ever fetched. Hence the pre-warmed anonymous state. Needs GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY in the capture environment.
